title: Voxkin
shortDescription: Talk to your OpenClaw agent. Your gateway, your configured AI.
fullDescription:
Your voice. Your gateway. Your choice of AI.

Voxkin is a privacy-focused voice client for your own OpenClaw setup. Talk to your agent from your Android phone without routing conversations through a Voxkin-hosted AI backend. Connect directly to the gateway you choose, using the agents, models, tools, and speech services configured there.

YOUR SETUP, NOT ANOTHER AI SERVICE
Voxkin does not add its own external AI or speech provider to your conversations. Your gateway controls which services handle requests. Use local services or cloud providers configured by you or your gateway administrator. No advertising SDK. No app analytics SDK. No Voxkin-hosted AI subscription required.

PRIVATE ACCESS FROM AWAY FROM HOME
Use Tailscale to reach your home gateway over a private VPN connection, without making the gateway publicly accessible. Tailscale is optional, installed separately, and requires your own network setup. Voxkin connects to your gateway using encrypted connections; credentials are stored in encrypted Android storage protected by Android Keystore.

SPEAK OR TYPE
Tap to talk and hear spoken answers, or use the keyboard when you prefer. Speech recognition runs on your Android device where supported, with no cloud recognition fallback. Stop playback or request cancellation of an active turn.

CHOOSE YOUR VOICE
Use your gateway's configured speech service. The optional Voxkin gateway plugin adds local English and Spanish voices, language selection, and voice previews. On-device dictation availability depends on your Android device and language setup.

INVITE ANOTHER PHONE
With the compatible plugin and gateway administrator approval, invite a phone to use an assigned agent. Restricted connections support conversation and voice, not agent tools. Gateway and network access must be arranged separately.

KNOW WHERE YOUR DATA GOES
Recognized text goes to your chosen gateway. That gateway may use configured external model, speech, or tool services. Direct connection does not mean all processing is local: those services and your gateway operator determine their own storage and retention. Clearing the phone's view does not delete gateway history.

REQUIRES YOUR OWN GATEWAY ACCESS
You need a compatible OpenClaw gateway that you own or have permission to use. Voxkin does not include a hosted AI assistant. Gateway hosting, Tailscale, and configured third-party services may have separate requirements or costs.

AI responses may be inaccurate. Verify important information. Voxkin is not an emergency service.

OPTIONAL RESPONSE REPORTS
Report an unsafe or offensive response from within the app. Review, edit or remove its text before submitting it to Builder of Things Studio. Reporting is optional; your other messages and gateway credentials are not attached.
releaseNotes: First Android internal-testing candidate. Direct OpenClaw connection, English/Spanish dictation, spoken replies, conversation history, QR setup and approved phone access. Requires your own compatible gateway. No Android Auto support.
